name: PEI Wildlife Conservation Fund project funding

funder.name: Prince Edward Island Wildlife Conservation Fund

summary: Project funding for wildlife on Prince Edward Island, including habitat restoration or enhancement in river, upland and wetland ecosystems, plus natural areas, education and research. Two intakes a year.
reporting: Successful projects report online through the application portal; deadlines are set in the funding approval.
